name: Traveling Trader
title: Produce Row
examine: Road dust on the boots, a stall's worth of somewhere else on the table, and eyes that price you the moment you say hello.
lines: Fresh off the First Road. What the fen didn't take, you're looking at.
Learn a trade before you leave here. Bretta's forge, Tilo's bench, Elowen's dispensary, all on one lane.
We sleep at the Wanderer's Rest and sell by the Round. Dunna's stew and a dry bed will do us.
